title: Patrick O'Donnell, former county commissioner and longtime borough lawyer, dies at 78
summary: O'Donnell, who died Nov. 11, won a Chester County commissioner's seat in 1979 as one of the county's few elected Democrats and practiced law in West Chester for 50 years, much of it in land use and municipal work. He also spent about 25 years on the board of Good Fellowship Ambulance.

title: Exton's Keva Flats wins county award for development that restored a floodplain
summary: Hankin Group's 266-unit apartment community on 19 acres received the Development Excellence Award in the 2026 Citizen Planner Awards from Chester County 2020 and the county Planning Commission. The project included a $2.4 million floodplain restoration begun in 2024 with West Whiteland Township.

title: Six holiday weekends start Nov. 27 with store discounts and free street parking
summary: The Greater West Chester Chamber of Commerce expects about 40,000 visitors for its downtown holiday campaign, which opens Black Friday with many of the roughly 180 shops and restaurants offering 20 to 30 percent off and other promotions. On-street parking is free Nov. 27 through 29, and the program runs through New Year's Day.

title: Friends group pays for a new brick sidewalk along Marshall Square Park
summary: A block-long red brick walk now runs along North Franklin Street from East Biddle Street to the fountain at Marshall Street, linking an existing crosswalk that had led nowhere. The Friends of Marshall Square Park covered the full cost with no borough money and also rebuilt two older brick walks with salvaged pavers.
loc: Marshall Square Park, N. Franklin St., West Chester

title: Golden Valley Farms Coffee marks 40 years with a Coffee Fest on Nov. 28
summary: The family-run West Goshen roaster, which has sold certified organic coffee since 2010, celebrates on Small Business Saturday at the Artisan Exchange with free mini cold brews and hot chocolate, local vendors and tours of the roasting room.
loc: Artisan Exchange, 208 Carter Drive, West Goshen

title: Greek-style coffee shop opens on West Gay Street; 7 Brew drive-thru follows Monday
summary: Brewing Love has opened at 145 W. Gay St., pouring freddos, the iced coffee popular in Greece, along with iced matcha and pastries. Drive-thru chain 7 Brew is set to open at 829 Paoli Pike on Monday, Nov. 16.

title: Museum and heritage center proposed beside Paoli Battlefield goes to Malvern council
summary: Paoli Memorial Grounds will ask Malvern Borough Council on Tuesday, Nov. 17, to approve a museum and heritage center at 404 Monument Ave., next to the Revolutionary War battlefield.

title: Korean comfort food cafe Maru brings back a closed restaurant's menu at Ludwig's Corner
summary: Maru opened in late August in the former Collective Coffee & Bakery space, serving coffee, pastries and doughnuts in the morning and Korean fried chicken sandwiches, wings and bao later in the day. Most of the menu is gluten-free or can be made so, and the cafe is BYOB.

title: SALT supporters launch $2 million drive to buy the theater's building
summary: After West Pikeland supervisors put the municipal building at 1645 Art School Road up for bid, three members of the Chester Springs theater community started a fundraiser so SALT Performing Arts can buy its home before bidding closes in early December. It has passed $60,000, and a donor is matching gifts up to $50,000.

title: Borough seals a time capsule to be opened in 50 years
summary: About 30 residents gathered at the Chester County Welcome Center in the Historic Courthouse to load a capsule with a library card, a Henderson High School yearbook, the borough flag, a Growers Market flyer and a painting of longtime hot dog vendor Scott "Wally" Vassil. Residents and schoolchildren donated the items through the borough's Parks and Recreation Department.
loc: Chester County Welcome Center, Historic Courthouse, West Chester
